summary.text: Graciela Guzmán represents the 20th District in the Illinois Senate and is an organizer for the Chicago Teachers Union, according to her office biography.

paragraphs.text: The biography says she previously was chief of staff for Sen. Cristina Pacione-Zayas, and that she graduated from Grinnell College in 2011 with a degree in anthropology.
It says her family immigrated to the United States from El Salvador and that she was campaign director for the Healthy Illinois campaign.
